purpose: Prospective positive-control study for mechanism-level ProxyGuard.
release_mechanism: Nonparametric row bootstrap of the source training table with replacement and unchanged sample size.
privacy_scope: This is a nonprivate fidelity control. It is not a synthetic-data privacy mechanism and supports no exposure claim.

learning_procedure.target_rule: The source procedure is fitted once. Each bootstrap release selects its own procedure on the same development validation set. Target outcomes are used only for the final paired audit.
